search.title: console
search.snippet: See also: consolé Borrowed from French console (“bracket”, noun), from consoler (“to console, to comfort”, verb). Sense of “bracket” either due to a bracket

search.snippet: console IPA(key): /kɔ̃.sɔ.le/ consolé (feminine consolée, masculine plural consolés, feminine plural consolées) past participle of consoler “consolé”
